titulo_da: Læsning 3 · Klima og energi i hverdagen
titulo_es: A transport proposal · Climate and energy in daily life

texto: A climate text can combine measurements, forecasts and recommendations. It identifies the source and degree of certainty; an observed effect does not in itself prove a single cause.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
